official_captions: Figure 10: Reconstruction quality versus inference cost on CelebA (128×128128\times 128). PSNR is averaged over the five restoration tasks of Table 1 (100 test images each); the horizontal axis is per-image wall-clock, measured on a single NVIDIA RTX A6000 and plotted on a log scale. Up and to the left is better. Our method is shown over Euler steps N∈{2,4,10,25}N\in\{2,4,10,25\} with K=5K{=}5 fixed, while each baseline contributes a single point. At N=2N{=}2 we exceed the strongest baseline (Flower5) at ≈50×\approx 50\times lower cost. PSNR decreases along our curve as NN grows because additional steps trade distortion for perceptual quality.
